_why: G4 human gate — the only path to Apply. This file ships EMPTY on purpose: no real DOL check has been done, and evidence typed here without one would be an invented record. An LCA is evidence of an intent to file, not an approved visa.
_how: After checking a role yourself, add one entry per role with every field below, then re-run. The tool refuses any entry that is incomplete, says the posting rules out sponsorship, targets a role whose timeline gate is 0, or targets a role whose company match is ambiguous or not-found.

_entry_shape.lca_evidence_source: e.g. DOL OFLC LCA disclosure data (file name / quarter you checked)
_entry_shape.liveness_checked_on: YYYY-MM-DD, the day you ran npm run ats:liveness -- <posting_url>
_entry_shape.checked_on: YYYY-MM-DD, the day you checked the LCA record
_entry_shape.reason: one or two sentences: what you saw and why it justifies applying
